effects: The signer sends exactly `assets` AUSD to the vault through safeTransferFrom. This spends the signer's AUSD allowance to the vault.
The vault mints bbqAUSD shares to `onBehalf`. The amount is previewDeposit(assets), computed from storage after accrueInterest. No minimum-shares bound exists.
The deposited AUSD goes on to the liquidity adapter. This is internal to the vault and does not change the signer's balance.
formats.shown: Deposit an exact AUSD amount into the vault, with bbqAUSD shares going to the onBehalf address. The share amount is not shown.

findings.title: deposit does not show how many bbqAUSD shares the signer receives; the contract computes it from storage.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.deposit: `uint256 shares = previewDeposit(assets); enter(assets, shares, onBehalf);`. There is no minShares parameter. Case 0 mints 10000000000000000 bbqAUSD (0.01) to the signer. The screen only shows 'Share ticker: bbqAUSD'.
findings.fix: No descriptor fix exists. The amount is derived from storage and the function has no slippage parameter.

findings.title: deposit shows a raw 'Share ticker' constant field that names the share token but no amount.
findings.evidence: descriptor deposit field `{"label": "Share ticker", "format": "raw", "value": "$.metadata.constants.vaultTicker"}`. It renders 'Share ticker: bbqAUSD'. The label 'Deposit asset' sits on an amount field.
findings.fix: Rename the labels to 'Amount to deposit' and 'Receive shares in', or name bbqAUSD in the intent, for example 'Deposit AUSD for bbqAUSD'.

cases.notes: The screen states the 0.01 AUSD out correctly. The bbqAUSD in (0.01) is shown only as a ticker and a recipient, with no amount. The reader got the direction and recipient right but not the amount.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: The vault burns bbqAUSD shares from `onBehalf`. The amount is previewWithdraw(assets), rounded up and computed from storage. No maximum-shares bound exists.
When msg.sender is not onBehalf, the call spends onBehalf's share allowance to the signer by that share amount.
The vault sends exactly `assets` AUSD to `receiver`.
formats.shown: Withdraw exactly N AUSD to the receiver, from the owner's position. The number of shares burned is not shown.

findings.title: withdraw does not show the bbqAUSD shares burned from the owner; the amount comes from storage.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.withdraw: `uint256 shares = previewWithdraw(assets); exit(assets, shares, receiver, onBehalf);` and exit: `deleteShares(onBehalf, shares);`. Case 1 burns 999999989997897909305 bbqAUSD from the signer. No field states it.
findings.fix: No descriptor fix exists. There is no maxShares parameter. Optionally add a hint such as the label 'Withdraw exactly (paid with your bbqAUSD shares)'.

cases.notes: The screen states the 1000 AUSD in to the signer correctly. The ~1000 bbqAUSD burned is not shown. The reader inferred shares leave but did not know the amount.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: The vault burns exactly `shares` bbqAUSD from `onBehalf`. When msg.sender is not onBehalf, this spends onBehalf's share allowance to the signer.
The vault sends AUSD to `receiver`. The amount is previewRedeem(shares), computed from storage. No minimum-assets bound exists.
formats.shown: Redeem an exact bbqAUSD share amount to the receiver, from the owner. The screen names neither the asset received nor its amount.

findings.title: redeem never names AUSD as the asset the receiver gets, though the descriptor has it as a constant.
findings.evidence: descriptor redeem intent 'Redeem', interpolatedIntent 'Redeem {#.shares} to {#.receiver}'. VaultV2.exit: `SafeERC20Lib.safeTransfer(asset, receiver, assets);` with asset = AUSD (immutable 0x...efe302beaa2b3e6e1b18d08d69a9012a). In case 2 the reader was unsure: 'Which asset I get back; the name suggests AUSD but the screen does not say'.
findings.fix: Change the intent to 'Redeem bbqAUSD for AUSD' and interpolatedIntent to 'Redeem {#.shares} for AUSD to {#.receiver}'.

findings.title: redeem does not show the AUSD amount received; previewRedeem computes it from storage with no minimum.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.redeem: `uint256 assets = previewRedeem(shares); exit(assets, shares, receiver, onBehalf);`. Case 2 pays the signer 4964999444 AUSD (4964.999444). No field states it.
findings.fix: No descriptor fix exists. The function has no minAssets parameter.

cases.notes: The screen states the 4964.999394370254634698 bbqAUSD burned correctly. The 4964.999444 AUSD in is not shown, as asset or amount. The reader guessed the asset and did not know the amount.
